method: Wikimedia Commons only (openly licensed; author, licence and source recorded per file). Candidates came from Commons searches for each stop's named place and from geotagged files within 250 m of each suggested boarding point. Each photo was opened and checked against its Commons description, visible signage and, where present, the camera geotag. None shows a shuttle boarding spot, so every one is marked as a nearby landmark. Images are Wikimedia's resized copies (1280 px and 500 px) with metadata removed; no other changes. No search-engine images or AI-generated images were used.

barone-traffic-circle.alt: John A. Barone Campus Center, a white building among trees, with a footpath and lamp post in front
barone-traffic-circle.match: Commons description: 'John A. Barone Campus Center at Fairfield University'; the building's name sign is visible at the right. Shows the building, not the Loyola Drive traffic circle (suggested point 73 m from the building). Undated, uploaded about 2008.

chapel-crosswalk.alt: Egan Chapel, a brick chapel with a white-trimmed gable and cross, beside a paved plaza and a white bell tower
chapel-crosswalk.match: Commons description: 'Egan Chapel of St. Ignatius Loyola at Fairfield University'. The suggested crosswalk is 57 m south of this chapel. Shows the chapel and plaza, not the crosswalk. Undated, uploaded about 2008.

quick-center-crosswalk.alt: Regina A. Quick Center for the Arts entrance canopy with the building's name, beside a curved drive and a flowering tree
quick-center-crosswalk.match: Commons description: 'Regina A. Quick Center for the Arts at Fairfield University'; the name is on the entrance canopy. The suggested crosswalk is 58 m east of the building. Taken 2008-04-19.

library-meditz-crosswalk.alt: DiMenna-Nyselius Library, a long three-storey building with wide front steps, seen across a lawn
library-meditz-crosswalk.match: Commons title and category: DiMenna-Nyselius Library, Fairfield University buildings. Camera geotag 41.1574, -73.2565 is about 115 m west of the suggested crosswalk. Shows the library, not Meditz Hall or the crosswalk. Taken 2011-04-26.

dsb-lower-lot-crosswalk.alt: Charles F. Dolan School of Business, a brick building with its name above the entrance, across a curved drive and crosswalk
dsb-lower-lot-crosswalk.match: Commons description: 'Dolan School of Business at Fairfield University'; 'Charles F. Dolan School of Business' is on the building. Shows the front entrance, not the lower-lot crosswalk on the west side. Undated, uploaded about 2008.

fairfield-train-station.alt: Fairfield train station, a brick station building on Unquowa Road, with the road bridge over the tracks at the right
fairfield-train-station.match: Commons description: '165 Unquowa Rd, Fairfield, CT' (Fairfield station). Camera geotag 41.142575, -73.258003 is 59 m from the suggested point on the Unquowa Road bridge, which is visible at the right edge. Shows the station from street level, not the top of the overpass. Taken 2020-10-04.

metro-train-alto.alt: Fairfield Metro station building with the red 'Fairfield Metro' sign, steps and glass stair towers
metro-train-alto.match: Commons description: 'The overpass at the Fairfield Metro station in Fairfield CT'; the 'Fairfield Metro' sign is visible. Camera geotag 41.1611, -73.2343 is 84 m from the suggested point. Whether this is the Alto garage side is not confirmed. Taken 2012-01-06.

bridgeport-train-station.alt: Bridgeport station area: a white six-storey public parking garage on Water Street, with the elevated station behind
bridgeport-train-station.match: Commons description: the Bridgeport Metro-North station and the adjacent parking garage on State Street at Water Street. Camera geotag 41.176772, -73.187474 is 141 m from the suggested point. The shuttle's boarding side is not published. Taken 2012-04-29.
